hooks.description: AST syntax verification on any edited Python file under scripts/ or skills/
hooks.command: python -c "import ast, sys, pathlib; p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); (ast.parse(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), filename=str(p)) if p.suffix=='.py' and ('scripts' in p.parts or 'skills' in p.parts) else None)" "$EDITED_FILE"

hooks.description: Guard: block destructive operations on vendored clinical-automation subproject (AGENTS.md §3.1)
hooks.command: python -c "import sys; cmd=sys.argv[1]; blocked=['rm ','rm -','mv ','sed -i','del ','rmdir']; sys.exit(1) if 'clinical-automation' in cmd and any(b in cmd for b in blocked) else None" "$COMMAND"

hooks.description: Guard: enforce scripts must be written to scripts/ directory (AGENTS.md §3)
hooks.command: python -c "import sys, pathlib; p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); sys.exit(1) if p.suffix=='.py' and 'scripts' not in p.parts and 'skills' not in p.parts and 'tests' not in p.parts and 'clinical_mcp' not in p.parts and 'pipeline' not in p.parts else None" "$TARGET_FILE"
